publication.body:
Closes #1249

#1145 could not publish because native proof rejected JavaScript tests and SPP edits left old operative plan steps. Add a constrained Node built-in test adapter and regenerate operative steps atomically on plan-class amendments.

Node proof requires tracked explicit files, canonical runner output and real passing named cases; existing candidate, timeout, cancellation, capture and review guards remain. Empty/skipped-only/failing/forged results and glob/unsafe paths are refused. Manual attestations remain non-executing.

Validation: native proof passed 10 installed regression tests across issue1249_, Cargo real/zero-test compatibility, and noncargo_ declarations. Independent exact-source review passed after fixing glob expansion. Isolated fixture proof is not deployment or hermetic dependency qualification.
